assets.label: 日常
assets.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: standalone mascot master PNG for the reading app Understand Book.
Input image role: approved identity and pose reference. Select ONLY the LEFTMOST cat in this three-cat sheet.

Create a single isolated full-body version of that exact LEFTMOST cat in a square transparent canvas. This is an asset extraction and cleanup, not a redesign. Preserve the approved smart, attentive expression exactly: softly lowered upper eyelids, both pupils coherently looking slightly toward viewer-right, tiny asymmetrical closed smile. Preserve the huge tilted round bean head, broad cream cheek cloud, small rounded triangle ears, orange nose, apricot cheek dots, short plump body, closed cream book with burnt-orange spine and ribbon hugged in both paws, forward feet with pads, curved tail on viewer-left with cream tip.

Keep the same proportions, contour character, illustration rendering, warm ink-brown and cream colors. Preserve the reference's recognizable organic rounded geometry, not a rigid reconstruction. No accessories, new markings, extra characters, text or scenery.

Center one complete character at about 78% of the square canvas height with comfortable transparent margins on every side; all ears, feet and tail fully visible. This same scale will be used for the rest of the asset family. Clean smooth alpha boundaries: remove the reference sheet's accidental loose white specks outside the actual silhouette, including under the left cheek and around the tail, while preserving intentional cream fur. No background, no ground shadow. Genuinely transparent PNG.

assets.label: 阅读

Preserve the central SPINE and the ribbon bookmark as baked orange #B65A17. The book should have cream covers, cream pages with pale beige edges, and small orange spine/ribbon accents, matching Yeye's established book.

Keep the cat completely unchanged: exact face, eyes looking down, smile, head tilt, colors, head/body proportions, paws, feet, tail, position and size. Keep the exact open-book shape and its edges; only recolor the large cover fields. Same square framing, same transparency. No text, no symbols, no new accessories.

initialGeneration.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: standalone Yeye mascot state for a reading app.
The supplied image is the APPROVED single-character master. Make the SAME character in the requested pose, preserving the exact round soft-bean head contour and large head/body ratio, broad cream cheek cloud, tiny orange nose, small rounded ears, compact plump body, cream chest, forward oval feet with apricot pads, thick curved tail with cream tip, and cream/baked-orange book. Preserve the warm ink-brown/cream/apricot/baked-orange palette and the reference's soft geometric 2D illustration. No new character design or accessories.
Square canvas, one full-body character, same apparent head size and foot baseline as the reference, comfortable transparent margins with all ears, feet and tail visible. Genuinely transparent background. Clean smooth alpha edges with no loose white specks. No lettering, labels, decorative symbols, scenery, shadows, fur texture or realism.

STATE: READING.
The cat is seated, holding the same book OPEN across its lower chest and lap with both round paws. Simple cream pages, baked-orange cover and central spine, one orange ribbon; only a couple of page-edge shapes, no written text. The book stays BELOW the face and the mouth remains visible. Eyes are both open with relaxed upper lids and substantial dark pupils. Both pupils look down toward the same area of the book, giving a clearly focused reading gaze. Keep a tiny asymmetrical closed smile, interested and quietly absorbed rather than sleepy. Head is gently tipped toward the book while retaining the familiar tilt. The big round cheeks and orange nose must stay recognizable. Same curved tail on viewer-left and feet planted in front. Change only the pose and eye direction needed for reading; keep identity stable.
